headline_marked: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in [[Chhatra Dal attack at RU]]
headline: 10 injured, including 4 journalists, in Chhatra Dal attack at RU
summary: Journalists were assaulted while filming a procession of Chhatra Dal activists carrying sharp weapons on the Rajshahi University campus.
details: At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Chhatra Dal activists at Rajshahi University (RU) on Sunday night.
The incident occurred around 8:30 PM near the Shahid Ziaur Rahman Hall when journalists attempted to film a procession of activists carrying sharp weapons, including 'ramdas'.
The attackers reportedly became enraged by the filming and physically assaulted the journalists and others present.
The tension on campus was sparked by a Facebook post made by Chhatra Dal leader M Ahsan Habib regarding RU Central Student Union (RAKSU) GS Salahuddin Ammar.
Chhatra Dal president Sultan Ahmed Rahi stated that the organization is investigating the incident and promised strict disciplinary action against any member found involved in the misconduct.
A two-member investigation committee led by ABM Ejazul Kabir Ruel and Manjurul Alam Riad has been formed to submit a report within 24 hours.
caption:
Journalists attacked at Rajshahi University for filming activists carrying sharp weapons.

At least 10 people, including four journalists, were injured in an attack by Chhatra Dal activists at Rajshahi University (RU) on Sunday night.

The incident occurred around 8:30 PM near the Shahid Ziaur Rahman Hall when journalists attempted to film a procession of activists carrying sharp weapons, including 'ramdas'.

The attackers reportedly became enraged by the filming and physically assaulted the journalists and others present.

The tension on campus was sparked by a Facebook post made by Chhatra Dal leader M Ahsan Habib regarding RU Central Student Union (RAKSU) GS Salahuddin Ammar.

Chhatra Dal president Sultan Ahmed Rahi stated that the organization is investigating the incident and promised strict disciplinary action against any member found involved in the misconduct.

A two-member investigation committee led by ABM Ejazul Kabir Ruel and Manjurul Alam Riad has been formed to submit a report within 24 hours.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Tk 252 hike: [[12kg LPG cylinder price rises]] to Tk 1,837
headline: Tk 252 hike: 12kg LPG cylinder price rises to Tk 1,837
summary: The Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC) has increased the price of liquefied petroleum gas, adding to consumer burdens.
details: The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder has been increased by Tk 252, bringing the new official price to Tk 1,837, according to the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC).
The decision was announced on Sunday, October 4, marking a significant jump from the previous official price of Tk 1,585.
Despite the official pricing, many consumers have reported that cylinders were already being sold at retail levels for nearly Tk 2,000.
In September, the price had been slightly reduced by Tk 13, bringing it down to Tk 1,585 from a previous rate of Tk 1,598.
Additionally, the price of LPG used in vehicles has also increased by Tk 11 per liter, with the new price set at Tk 84.62 per liter.
caption:
LPG prices just jumped by Tk 252. A 12kg cylinder now officially costs Tk 1,837.

The price of a 12kg LPG cylinder has been increased by Tk 252, bringing the new official price to Tk 1,837, according to the Bangladesh Energy Regulatory Commission (BERC).

The decision was announced on Sunday, October 4, marking a significant jump from the previous official price of Tk 1,585.

Despite the official pricing, many consumers have reported that cylinders were already being sold at retail levels for nearly Tk 2,000.

In September, the price had been slightly reduced by Tk 13, bringing it down to Tk 1,585 from a previous rate of Tk 1,598.

Additionally, the price of LPG used in vehicles has also increased by Tk 11 per liter, with the new price set at Tk 84.62 per liter.
